import sys
import math

def main():
    input = sys.stdin.read().splitlines()
    n = int(input[0])
    s = input[1]
    c = list(s)
    countV = 0
    countK = 0
    countOthers = 0
    frequency = [[0, 0, 0] for _ in range(n + 1)]
    positions = [[] for _ in range(3)]
    index = 0
    for ch in c:
        frequency[index + 1][:] = frequency[index][:]
        index += 1
        if ch == 'V':
            frequency[index][0] += 1
            countV += 1
            positions[0].append(index)
        elif ch == 'K':
            frequency[index][1] += 1
            countK += 1
            positions[1].append(index)
        else:
            frequency[index][2] += 1
            countOthers += 1
            positions[2].append(index)
    memo = [[[[-1 for _ in range(4)] for _ in range(countOthers + 1)] for _ in range(countK + 1)] for _ in range(countV + 1)]
    
    def compute(countUsed, maxCount, pos, freq, dp):
        v, k, s = countUsed
        cv, ck, cs = maxCount
        if v == cv and k == ck and s == cs:
            return 0
        if dp[v][k][s][0] != -1:
            return dp[v][k][s][0]
        res = math.inf
        if v < cv:
            p = pos[0][v]
            moveCost = max(freq[p][0] - v, 0) + max(freq[p][1] - k, 0) + max(freq[p][2] - s, 0) - 1
            newCount = list(countUsed)
            newCount[0] += 1
            res = min(res, compute(newCount, maxCount, pos, freq, dp) + moveCost)
        if k < ck:
            p = pos[1][k]
            moveCost = max(freq[p][0] - v, 0) + max(freq[p][1] - k, 0) + max(freq[p][2] - s, 0) - 1
            newCount = list(countUsed)
            newCount[1] += 1
            res = min(res, compute(newCount, maxCount, pos, freq, dp) + moveCost)
        if s < cs:
            p = pos[2][s]
            moveCost = max(freq[p][0] - v, 0) + max(freq[p][1] - k, 0) + max(freq[p][2] - s, 0) - 1
            newCount = list(countUsed)
            newCount[2] += 1
            res = min(res, compute(newCount, maxCount, pos, freq, dp) + moveCost)
        dp[v][k][s][0] = res
        return res

    print(compute([0, 0, 0], [countV, countK, countOthers], positions, frequency, memo))
